_: Yedi yil boyunca tekrar eden figur: gozleri capraz, agzi kimi zaman dikili, govdesi ust uste daireler. Kutular kirpilmis tablonun icinde [sol, ust, genislik, yukseklik] kesridir.
name: The onlooker

crops.line: Blue, stacked two and three high, ranged across the board
A row of them standing along the boat
White and tufted, crossed eyes and a stitched mouth
Ovoid clusters marked with an X, hung at the upper left
Three of them, arms linked, before the mountain
Three at the foot of the white heap, and one floating clear of it
Hung upside down at the upper left, fingers spread
Red, drawn in a crowd, one of them raised above the rest
